rule: Every resolved place remains selectable with its canonical score; only independently worthwhile settlements scoring 60 or more appear as town markers.
namingDecisions: Froickhein is normalised to Friockheim and Arbrouath to Arbroath.
Marywell resolves to the Arbroath and St Vigeans settlement and remains distinct from Marywell at Birse and Marywell near Portlethen.
Chapeltown resolves to the DD11 4RT locality near Inverkeilor.
Ethie Castle and Letham Grange estate evidence remains separate from settlement merit.

additions.name: Friockheim
additions.rationale: The requested spelling is normalised to Friockheim. The village remains below the tourist-map threshold pending a full visitor audit.

additions.name: Boysack
additions.rationale: Boysack is retained as a distinct rural locality without inheriting nearby estate or village attractions.

additions.name: Inverkeilor
additions.rationale: Inverkeilor has a coherent village identity but remains below 60 until its independent See, café, trail and visitor-facility offer is fully audited.

additions.name: Ethie Mains
additions.rationale: Ethie Mains remains a regional reference and does not inherit Ethie Castle or coastal attraction value.

additions.name: Ethie Castle
additions.rationale: The castle is principally an attraction or heritage property, not evidence of a tourist settlement; any public visitor value belongs under See.

additions.name: Drunkendub
additions.rationale: Drunkendub is retained for regional selection but has no verified independent destination-scale offer.

additions.name: Auchmithie
additions.rationale: Auchmithie has strong independent character but remains just below 60 until a full audit checks access, cafés, trails, parking, toilets and picnic provision.

additions.name: Marywell
additions.rationale: This is the Marywell in Arbroath and St Vigeans parish, kept distinct from the existing Birse and Portlethen records.

additions.name: Hayshead
additions.rationale: Hayshead remains selectable as a named district but does not independently inherit Arbroath attractions or services.

additions.name: Cliffburn
additions.rationale: Cliffburn is retained as a district reference; nearby coast and Arbroath-wide attractions do not create an independent tourist-town score.

additions.name: Arbroath
additions.rationale: The requested spelling is normalised to Arbroath. It clearly merits a full audit but remains below 60 until its complete See, café, trails, parking, toilets, picnic and Treasure Trails evidence is checked.

additions.name: Elliot
additions.rationale: Elliot remains distinct from Arbroath and does not automatically inherit the beach, golf or wider town offer.

additions.name: St Vigeans
additions.rationale: St Vigeans has strong church and village character, but remains below 60 pending a full independent visitor audit and separation from Arbroath services.

additions.name: Letham Grange
additions.rationale: Letham Grange is retained as a locality; estate or golf evidence is assessed separately and does not create a tourist settlement.

additions.name: Cauldcots
additions.rationale: Cauldcots remains a regional reference without borrowing Inverkeilor or neighbouring estate value.

additions.name: Leysmill
additions.rationale: Leysmill has a distinct mapped identity but no verified complete visitor offer at the settlement level.

additions.name: Chapeltown
additions.rationale: Chapeltown resolves to the DD11 4RT locality near Inverkeilor. A postcode centroid requires a cautious boundary and no neighbouring attractions are borrowed.
